scope: Owner-approved native Glass chrome refinement; Glass Power Tools visionOS reference; synthetic images; original implementation checkpoint preceded separately recorded physical deployment
changes: Separate native controls in ToolbarItemGroup(.bottomOrnament), without enclosing stacks, manual spacing, fixed label frames or forced icon-only toolbar label styles.
Native capsule title surface with retained responsive filename, original metadata and document actions.
Removed redundant outer glass around the native annotation Form/NavigationStack.
Native Options moves into Drawing Tools only at compact/accessibility text sizes; explicit names and every command retained.
Existing plain-window single rear glass, corner/insets, Opacity/Glass controls, opaque foreground and image/source behavior retained.

reference.project: Glass Power Tools, read-only visionOS source comparison
symbols: GlassNativeWindowFrame: separate ToolbarItemGroup controls and capsule title
GlassSpatialWindowGlass: one native rear glass in a plain window
GlassLayeredPanel: embedded panels do not paint extra material
DesktopSessionView: let visionOS toolbar choose native label presentation
reference.platform_boundary: GlassWindowChrome and relevant glassEffect implementations are gated to other platforms; no macOS Liquid Glass implementation or external dependency was imported.

ui.system_palette: Actual RGB/live-color/one-Undo check passed; prior system-host audit -902 limit remains.

visual_findings_and_corrections.finding: All four initial UI cases passed, but actual compositor/hierarchy review exposed an 802-point largest-text toolbar in a 720-point window. Existing largest-text audit did not check width.
visual_findings_and_corrections.correction: Retain native sizes; move Options into Drawing Tools at compact/accessibility sizes. Strengthened existing test to assert actual toolbar bounds, open text options from that menu and audit the panel.

contrast_scope.normal_preview: First/default/compact/panel previews used normal contrast. Earlier build-11 audit screenshots used Increase Contrast and are not a controlled material comparison.

retained_baselines.core: 57 test definitions/three suites retained by unchanged core/test hashes; not rerun this presentation-only task.
retained_baselines.native_services: 30 model/service checks retained by unchanged owners/fixtures; not rerun.

limits: At implementation checkpoint build 12 was prepared locally; subsequent owner-requested installation/normal launch/process verification passed. See deploymentFollowUp/physical-deployment.json.
Native audit passes do not establish headset VoiceOver/Voice Control/Switch Control speech/focus, keyboard/gaze/hold comfort or installed icon behavior.
No new recipient interoperability, large-image resource profile, first-run Photos consent tap or physical capture is claimed.
Responsive metadata/document actions remain composed inside a native title ornament; canvas geometry/handles remain intentionally app-specific.

reproduction.ui: xcodebuild test -project GlassImageTools.xcodeproj -scheme GlassImageTools -configuration Debug -destination "platform=visionOS Simulator,id=$SIMULATOR_ID" -derivedDataPath "$UI_BUILD_DIR" -parallel-testing-enabled NO CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO
reproduction.focused: Select HIGPolishTests compact/default/visible-panel/Share/Pan/tiny cases; native Shapes, zoomed-crop and appearance cases; all four AccessibilityAuditTests.
reproduction.contrast: Save simctl ui "$SIMULATOR_ID" increase_contrast; run largest-text with enabled, then restore the original value.
reproduction.release: xcodebuild -project GlassImageTools.xcodeproj -scheme GlassImageTools -configuration Release -destination generic/platform=visionOS -derivedDataPath "$DEVICE_BUILD_DIR" -allowProvisioningUpdates build analyze
